question: Do exact primary sources expose independently measured, reusable multi-channel film-recorder response rows sufficient to identify a non-spatial interimage operator without fitting another heuristic to photographs?
claim_ceiling: bounded source and data-feasibility audit; not a film-stock response, stock/process/scanner calibration, operator fit, product profile or authenticity claim

sources.citation: Helen Hae-Kyung Shin, The Colorimetric characterization of CRT-based digital film recorders, RIT thesis, 1996

sources.citation: Mark D. Fairchild, Roy S. Berns, Audrey A. Lester and Hae Kyung Shin, Accurate Color Reproduction of CRT Displayed Images as Projected 35mm Slides, CIC 1994
